concerns.text: Task T052 (Integrate Cluster Permutation & FDR) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This task is the sole deliverable for FR-006 (FDR correction) and FR-007 (cluster-aware permutation) integration. Without this task, the system cannot generate the adjusted p-values required by SC-005, constituting a direct failure to satisfy the spec's functional requirements.

Task T033 (Retrain on Top 3 Features) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). This task is the only mechanism to satisfy SC-003, which requires measuring the R² of a model trained *only* on the top 3 descriptors against a null baseline. The spec mandates this measurement; the task list fails to provide the implementation path.

Tasks T054 (Implement Runtime Logger) and T055 (Persist Runtime Log) are marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). FR-009 explicitly requires the system to generate and persist `data/benchmarks/runtime_log.json`. The absence of these tasks means the runtime logging requirement is unimplemented in the execution plan.

Tasks T014ba, T014bb, and T014bc implement optional descriptors (Kinetic Diameter, LJ epsilon, Quadrupole) with logic to raise `DescriptorCalculationError` or `DependencyMissingError` if dependencies fail. FR-001 requires a 'configurable set' of descriptors. The current task design implies a hard failure (termination) if optional dependencies are missing, which violates the 'configurable' nature of the requirement. The tasks must be revised to handle missing optional dependencies gracefully (e.g., skip calculation, log warning) rather than raising fatal errors that break the pipeline.
